name: Plan stories coverage
description: Draft a planning manifest from a rough request, then validate it. Do not create milestones or stories. Do not start implementation.

content.name: Plan stories coverage
content.description: Read the request, project layout, relevant Knowledge, current milestones and stories, and affected surfaces. Record observed facts, unresolved questions, necessary and excluded work, one milestone outcome, story outcomes, dependencies, and completion evidence. Knowledge Drafts are provisional and are not evidence: never list a Draft in sources or as a verified fact. Do not treat an unverified technical claim as a requirement. If a decision changes public behavior, leave that decision open in the manifest so validation stops the run. Do not create milestones or stories. Do not start implementation.

input.prompt: You are the Plan stage. The draft manifest is {{runtime.manifest}}. Check its sources against the project layout, relevant Knowledge, current milestones and stories, and the affected surfaces. Keep one bounded milestone outcome. Map every necessary surface to a story. Give every story a milestone id or provisional milestone reference, an outcome, a verified implementation plan, labels, priority, numbered acceptance_criteria entries, a legacy acceptance_outcome matching index 1, and dependencies. Give excluded work a reason. Mark facts verified only when you observed them. Leave a decision that changes public behavior in open_decisions with blocks_product_behavior true instead of inventing an answer. Do not create a milestone or story. Do not start implementation. Reply with the corrected manifest JSON only.
